title: Pay workers' compensation to injured seafarers (Seacare)
what: An employer is liable to pay compensation for an injury suffered by an employee covered by the Seacare scheme.

sources.title: Seafarers Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 1992
sources.quote: 24 Liability to pay compensation The liability of an employer to pay compensation to a person under this Act is the liability of the employer to pay the amount or amounts that the employer determines, in accordance with this Act, to be payable to the person.

reach.condition: if it employs seafarers covered by the Seacare scheme
